subject: Thanks and quick schedule change
text: Hi Sam, thank you for helping with event prep. You made a tough job look easy. I also have a time-sensitive change. The main session starts earlier now. Setup must finish by seven thirty. That is instead of nine. Please confirm today so I can adjust signs. Your flexibility is much appreciated. I hope we work together again soon. Thanks again for steady support. It saved us. You deserve credit. Well done.
